My primary symptom: Severe lower abdominal pain and dyspnea after catheter drainage failure.

When you say “catheter drainage failure,” what kind of catheter is it (urinary Foley/suprapubic, nephrostomy, peritoneal drain, dialysis catheter, etc.), and what was it placed for?

Also: when did the severe lower abdominal pain and shortness of breath start (sudden vs gradual), and do you have any fever/chills or inability to pass urine/gas?

message.content:
It’s a catheter for my urinary pouch. I had a radical cystectomy a while back, so I have a continent MAINZ pouch I urinary diversion. The catheter was placed in the pouch for continuous drainage because I’ve been having a lot of trouble catheterizing it myself over the last few weeks.

The pain and the shortness of breath started after the catheter stopped working last night. It’s been getting worse since then. I haven't been able to get any urine out since the drainage failed. I don't have any fever or chills that I've noticed, and I'm still able to pass gas.
